mapper.select: SELECT * FROM film_stock WHERE status = #{status} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE film_stock SET available_area = available_area - #{lockArea}, locked_area = locked_area + #{lockArea}, available_rolls = available_rolls - #{lockRolls}, locked_rolls = locked_rolls + #{lockRolls}, available_pack_count = COALESCE(available_pack_count, available_rolls) - #{lockRolls}, locked_pack_count = COALESCE(locked_pack_count, locked_rolls) + #{lockRolls}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND available_area >= #{lockArea} AND available_rolls >= #{lockRolls}

UPDATE film_stock SET available_area = available_area + #{unlockArea}, locked_area = locked_area - #{unlockArea}, available_rolls = available_rolls + #{unlockRolls}, locked_rolls = locked_rolls - #{unlockRolls}, available_pack_count = COALESCE(available_pack_count, available_rolls) + #{unlockRolls}, locked_pack_count = COALESCE(locked_pack_count, locked_rolls) - #{unlockRolls}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND locked_area >= #{unlockArea} AND locked_rolls >= #{unlockRolls}

UPDATE film_stock SET total_area = total_area - #{outArea}, total_rolls = total_rolls - #{outRolls}, total_pack_count = COALESCE(total_pack_count, total_rolls) - #{outRolls}, locked_area = CASE WHEN locked_area >= #{outArea} AND locked_rolls >= #{outRolls} THEN locked_area - #{outArea} ELSE locked_area END, locked_rolls = CASE WHEN locked_area >= #{outArea} AND locked_rolls >= #{outRolls} THEN locked_rolls - #{outRolls} ELSE locked_rolls END, locked_pack_count = CASE WHEN locked_area >= #{outArea} AND locked_rolls >= #{outRolls} THEN COALESCE(locked_pack_count, locked_rolls) - #{outRolls} ELSE COALESCE(locked_pack_count, locked_rolls) END, available_area = CASE WHEN locked_area >= #{outArea} AND locked_rolls >= #{outRolls} THEN available_area ELSE available_area - #{outArea} END, available_rolls = CASE WHEN locked_area >= #{outArea} AND locked_rolls >= #{outRolls} THEN available_rolls ELSE available_rolls - #{outRolls} END, available_pack_count = CASE WHEN locked_area >= #{outArea} AND locked_rolls >= #{outRolls} THEN COALESCE(available_pack_count, available_rolls) ELSE COALESCE(available_pack_count, available_rolls) - #{outRolls} END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND ((locked_area >= #{outArea} AND locked_rolls >= #{outRolls}) OR (available_area >= #{outArea} AND available_rolls >= #{outRolls}))
